harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on AlmaLinux 9. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, then rebuilt the former primary (node1) as a new standby of node2 via pg_basebackup after pg_rewind was blocked by missing wal_log_hints. Final steady state: node2 primary, node1 and node3 both streaming standbys, all committed rows (including a write made only after failover) consistent across all three nodes. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: restarted node3, node1, then node2 (primary last) one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed a changed OS boot_id on each, and verified PostgreSQL/replication fully recovered after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG repo and postgresql16-server/contrib on node1, node2, node3
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Initialized primary DB on node1, configured wal_level/max_wal_senders/pg_hba.conf for replication
Created replicator role and appdb.t table with baseline data on node1
Cloned node2 and node3 as standbys via pg_basebackup -R (streaming, async)
Verified initial replication: both standbys in recovery, WAL LSNs matched primary
Inserted pre-failover rows and confirmed both standbys caught up (same LSN, same rows)
Stopped PostgreSQL on node1 to simulate primary loss
Promoted node2 via pg_ctl promote; confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=f and successful write of a new row
Repointed node3's primary_conninfo to node2, fixed .pgpass wildcard entry, confirmed streaming from node2 on new timeline 2 with all 5 rows present

Attempted pg_rewind on node1 (failed: missing wal_log_hints/checksums); instead wiped node1 data dir and re-cloned via pg_basebackup from node2 as new standby, restored least-privilege (revoked temporary superuser grant on replicator)
Verified final 3-node topology: node2 primary with node1 and node3 streaming standbys, identical data on all nodes
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full replication/data recovery
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full replication/data recovery
Restarted node2 (primary) via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, pg_is_in_recovery=f, both standbys reconnected, and all data intact

evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
evidence.summary: node1 active as primary with pg_stat_replication showing node2 and node3 streaming; both standbys report pg_is_in_recovery=t and hold the same baseline rows as the primary

evidence.requirement: Committed data replicated to standbys before disruption (no-data-loss baseline)
evidence.summary: Pre-failover rows 3 and 4 inserted on node1 (LSN 0/4000330) and confirmed present on node2 and node3 at matching replay LSN 0/4022F68

evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated as smallest safe, reversible disruption
evidence.summary: PostgreSQL service stopped on node1 only; node2 and node3 remained up preserving an independent recovery path

evidence.requirement: Standby promoted to writable primary without losing committed data
evidence.summary: node2 promoted (pg_is_in_recovery=f), all 4 pre-failover rows intact, and a new write (row 5) accepted confirming writable primary with zero data loss

evidence.requirement: Surviving standby re-pointed to new primary and catches up
evidence.summary: node3 log shows it switched to timeline 2 and streamed from node2; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node3 streaming; node3 query shows all 5 rows including the post-failover write

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary rejoins as standby of current primary
evidence.summary: pg_rewind blocked by missing wal_log_hints, so node1 was re-cloned via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=t), and confirmed streaming under node2's pg_stat_replication with full 5-row data set matching primary

evidence.requirement: Baseline boot identity and health captured on all nodes before restart protocol
evidence.summary: boot_id captured for node1 (84419b90...), node2 (717db5a2...), node3 (f54d7366...) prior to any restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed f54d7366->c1d33b08; postgresql-16 active, in recovery, row count 5, reconnected to node2's pg_stat_replication

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed 84419b90->aca5803b; postgresql-16 active, in recovery, row count 5, reconnected to node2's pg_stat_replication

evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, quorum/full health before completion
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed 717db5a2->ebbe42b2; postgresql-16 active, pg_is_in_recovery=f (still primary), both node1 and node3 reconnected as streaming standbys, and all 5 rows verified intact
